Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
1.

Shri Raj Kumar Mishra, Advocate has filed his vakalatnama on behalf of opposite party no.2 today
in Court, which is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State, Shri Raj Kumar Mishra,
learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and perused the record.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that on account of monetary dispute between the parties, the instant criminal case was instituted against the applicant, however subsequently, with the intervention of respected members of both the family and the society, the parties have amicably and genuinely settled their all disputes and differences and now, they do not have any grievance against each other.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant has next drawn the attention of the Court to the settlement agreement dated 28.04.2023 drawn between the parties, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexure 5 to this application.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant has next submitted that this Court vide its order dated 08.06.2023 had directed the parties to appear before the court below and get the said settlement agreement verified.

6. Pursuant to the said order dated 08.06.2023, the parties appeared before the court below and in their presence, the said settlement agreement has been verified and a verification report dated 21.06.2023 has been forwarded to this Court, a copy of which has been annexed as Annexure 6 to this application.

7. Learned counsel for the applicant has next submitted that in view of the said settlement agreement dated 28.04.2023 drawn between the parties and as well as verification report dated 21.06.2023, the entire proceedings be quashed.
8. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has also appeared and has acknowledged the said settlement agreement dated 28.04.2023 drawn between the parties.
9. Learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 has further, on instructions, submitted that opposite party no.2 has no objection, if the entire proceedings are quashed.
10. Learned AGA could not dispute the aforesaid facts.

11. This Court is not unmindful of the judgements of the Hon?ble Apex Court in the cases of:-
(i). B.S. Joshi and others Vs. State of Haryana and another, (2003) 4 SCC 675.

sentences.text: Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, as noted herein above, and also the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court is of the considered opinion that no useful purpose would be served by prolonging the proceedings of the present case.

14. Accordingly, the entire proceedings of Case No. 639 of 2023 (State Vs. Babli Kumar), arising out of Case Crime No. 120 of 2022, under Sections 420, 406 IPC, Police Station Nawabganj, District Bareilly, pending in the court of Judicial Magistrate, Nawabganj, Bareilly, are hereby quashed.
